messages:
sara (partnerships): quick sync — marketplace GTM artifacts need lock tomorrow so partner can schedule press. main asks: press release, joint blog, partner marketplace listing, landing page, co-branded assets. who owns each?

emma (marketing): I can own press + blog. need partner quotes and final logo assets by EOD today. also a short byline from product (2-3 sentences). :spiral_calendar:

jake (product): can draft a 2-sentence byline. will push to the doc in 30m. any tech-specific claims we should avoid?

tara (legal): avoid SLA or performance claims we haven't validated. also need partner sign-off on joint messaging and embargo time. request: send draft PR and proposed embargo window for review.

sara (partnerships): embargo suggested: Tue 09:00 PT. partner has channel constraints — they want 24h heads-up.

alex (partner-success): partner can provide quotes and a co-author on the blog. logos coming in a zip (SVG + PNG) but needs to be cleared for trademark use. sending to @tara when I get it.

ow: checklist I want ticked before EOD tomorrow:
- press draft (marketing)
- joint blog draft (marketing + partner)
- marketplace listing draft + images (partnerships + product)
- landing page copy + hero assets (marketing)
- legal sign-off + embargo confirmation (legal)
- ops deployment plan for listing (eng)

ewen (eng): ops can do the marketplace listing push and landing page deploy. need product to confirm model slug and version, and marketplace credentials from partner. ETA: can deploy within 6 hours of receiving assets.

jake (product): model slug = `redwood-r1.2-optimized`. will confirm version and provide sample inference metrics (latency/p99) for PR.

emma (marketing): page layout done, waiting on hero image + partner logo + 1 quote. will wireframe the CTA to marketplace link.

tara (legal): start reviewing once PR draft is posted. please flag any customer data or security guarantees in the copy — we'll need exact wording if we mention compliance.

sara (partnerships): potential blocker: partner legal wants to review assets on Monday morning — that shortens our window. can we aim to have all drafts in #drive by Monday 08:00 PT?

alex (partner-success): confirmed — partner legal review Mon 08:00 PT. I'll expedite logos and a quote tonight.

emma (marketing): copy deadline: Mon 06:00 PT to give legal 2 hours. can everyone commit?

jake (product): yes, will post by Mon 04:30 PT with metrics.

owen (eng): ops ready, but need marketplace account creds before deploy. alex — can partner create a listing account or do we publish on their behalf?

alex (partner-success): partner prefers we publish the listing on their marketplace profile, they'll invite our org tonight.

release-bot: deployment window booked for Tue 10:00 PT -> staging push at 08:00 PT.

sara (partnerships): OK final notes: Emma owns press+page, Jake owns product copy + metrics, Owen owns deploy, Tara legal sign-off, Alex = partner liaison. Everyone drop artifacts into the drive folder `marketplace_coannounce/1794567890` and ping here when done. :white_check_mark:

emma (marketing): will post PR draft in 25m.

jake (product): posted metric snippet and 2-sentence byline.

(note: smaller thread follow-ups will happen in docs, this thread is to record owners/timeline and blockers.)
